profile.device: Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia, ARM64, Mali-G76 MC4, Android API 33)
profile.observation: The original EA SHIFT intro mark was on screen during this running session. The sampled app used the previously installed Process 2 plugin, before this R8 optimization.

retail_bink_contract.sample_equivalence: Sampling R8_UNORM produces (R,0,0,1); the captured [X,X,X,One] descriptor yields (R,R,R,1), matching the prior CPU-expanded RGBA plane.

change.activation_guard: format 2, endian mode 0, and decoded sampler swizzle exactly [X,X,X,One]
change.texture_upload: Preserve matching untiled linear planes as one-byte R8_UNORM images; all other layouts keep the existing RGBA8 untile/expand path.
change.removed_copy: Do not copy the first texture plane into the legacy texture_rgba8 field when the multi-texture list is populated.

verification.host_native_vulkan: 4/4 CTest cases passed on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950, including the mixed R8/RGBA8 Vulkan renderer check.
verification.host_plugin: 3/3 Process 2 plugin CTest cases passed with VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation enabled.
verification.android: Renderer test target cross-compiled for Android API 26 / arm64-v8a; updated Process 2 plugin translation unit compiled against the resolve-capable SDK branch.
verification.device_install_or_run: not performed; the existing phone game process was left running.
verification.performance_claim: No before/after speedup measurement is available. The profile is a baseline from the previous installed binary; payload reduction is derived from the captured plane dimensions.

limitations: The optimization covers the captured linear R8 Bink plane layout and matching swizzle only; other video formats still use the existing RGBA8 conversion path.

This reduces CPU-side texture expansion and Vulkan upload bytes but does not address per-frame Vulkan object creation, queue-idle waits, guest/runtime CPU usage, or the unresolved cutscene-to-menu transition.

The full Android APK cannot currently be rebuilt with depth/stencil resolve enabled because the shared ReXGlue Android runtime still has the separate Bionic ucontext fiber gap documented in process2_provider_resolve_integration_20261024.json.
